chalisa.cau1: Salutations, salutations to you, Durgā, giver of happiness; salutations, salutations to you, Ambā, remover of sorrow. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Your light is formless; its brightness has spread through the three worlds. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: The moon is on your forehead and your face is vast; your eyes are red and your brows fearsome. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: The Mother's form is most lovely; seeing it, people find great joy. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: As Śakti you brought the world to dissolution, and for its sustenance you gave food and wealth. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Becoming Annapūrṇā, you sustained the world; you alone are the primal, beautiful maiden, Bālā. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: At the time of dissolution you destroy all; you are Gaurī, beloved of Śiva. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Śiva and the yogīs sing your virtues; Brahmā and Viṣṇu meditate on you always. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: You took the form of Sarasvatī, and by giving good understanding you saved the seers and sages. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Ambā, you took the form of Narasiṃha and appeared, tearing the pillar apart. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Protecting Prahlāda, you saved him, and you sent Hiraṇyakaśipu to heaven. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: You took the form of Lakṣmī in the world, and you dwell within the body of Śrī Nārāyaṇa. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: You take your delight in the Ocean of Milk. Ocean of mercy, fulfil the hope of my heart. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Bhavānī, it is you at Hiṅgalāja; your boundless glory cannot be described. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: You are Mother Mātaṅgī and Dhūmāvatī, and Bhuvaneśvarī and Bagalā, the givers of joy. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: You are Śrī Bhairavī, and Tārā who carries the world across, and Chinnamastā of the severed head, who removes the sorrows of worldly existence. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Bhavānī looks resplendent on her lion mount; the hero Lāṅgura goes before her. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: In your hands shine the skull-bowl and the sword; seeing them, Death flees in fear. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Your weapons and trident gleam, and at them a pang rises in the enemy's heart. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: It is you who dwell at Nagarkoṭ; your drum resounds through the three worlds. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: You slew the demons Śumbha and Niśumbha, and destroyed Raktabīja and Śaṅkhāsura and his like. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Mahiṣāsura, the king, was exceedingly proud; under the weight of his sins the earth was in torment. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: You took the dreadful form of Kālikā and destroyed him along with his army. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Whenever hardship fell on the saints, Mother, each time you came to their help. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: The city of the immortals and all the other worlds remained free of sorrow through your glory. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Your light is in the flame at Jvālā; men and women worship you always. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: When someone sings your glory with love and devotion, sorrow and poverty do not come near him. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: The one who meditates on you with his mind intent is released from birth and death. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Yogīs, gods and sages proclaim aloud: Without your power there is no yoga. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Śaṅkarācārya practised austerities and conquered desire and anger, every one. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Night and day he meditated on Śiva; at no time did he remember you. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: He did not grasp the secret of your form as Śakti; when his power left him, he repented in his heart. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: He came to your refuge and told of your glory: Victory, victory, victory to you, Bhavānī, Mother of the world. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: The primal Mother of the world was pleased; she gave him power and made no delay. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Mother, great distress has closed in on me; who but you can take away my sorrow? ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Hope and craving torment me terribly; a foolish enemy frightens me greatly. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Destroy the enemy, great queen; with a single mind I remember you, Bhavānī. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Be gracious, merciful Mother; grant me prosperity and attainment and make me content. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: As long as I live, may I receive the fruit of your mercy, and may I always tell of your glory. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Those who sing the Durgā Chālīsā enjoy every happiness and attain the supreme state. ॥40॥
chalisa.cau41: Knowing Devīdāsa to be in your refuge, be gracious, Bhavānī, Mother of the world. ॥41॥
chalisa.do1: You protect those who come to you for refuge, and your devotee lives free from fear. I have come to your refuge, Mother: take me into your lap.
